sessions_status_check.name: sessions_status_check
sessions_status_check.value: (status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('ACTIVE'::character varying)::text, ('PROCESSING'::character varying)::text, ('REVIEW'::character varying)::text, ('COMPLETED'::character varying)::text, ('CANCELLED'::character varying)::text])

users_role_check.name: users_role_check
users_role_check.value: (role)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('admin'::character varying)::text, ('reviewer'::character varying)::text, ('compliance_officer'::character varying)::text, ('doctor'::character varying)::text, ('coder'::character varying)::text])

public.monthly_usage.name: monthly_usage
public.monthly_usage.definition: SELECT c.id AS client_id, c.name AS client_name, ul.endpoint, date_trunc('month'::text, ul.called_at) AS billing_month, count(*) AS total_calls FROM usage_logs ul JOIN api_clients c ON c.id = ul.client_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, ul.endpoint, (date_trunc('month'::text, ul.called_at))
